notes: Primary contact: CTO Elena Morris; product lead is Diego Alvarez (conversational UX).
Business problem: high variance in inference cost + p95 latency spikes impacting SLA to enterprise customers.
Current footprint: multi-tenant hosted API for beta customers, ~20k MAU across product features.
POC objective: validate Dedicated latency SLOs, measure unit-cost improvements, and prove safe rollouts w/ canary + fallbacks.
Performance targets: p50 < 120ms for chat gen, p95 < 450ms at 95th percentile during load; embeddings tail < 300ms.
Throughput target for POC: sustain 60 qps steady-state with 5x burst for peak shopping windows.
Canary plan (agreed in SE session): 10% production traffic to Dedicated canary for 48h, monitor latency, error-rate, cost, quality drift.
Fallback routing: traffic routing policy will demote to a quantized model variant (lower-cost) or fall back to Hosted API region in case of Dedicated degradation.
Model variants: primary - llama-2-70b-quant-8, fallback - llama-2-70b-quant-4, cold-fallback - hosted gpt-compatible endpoint.
Region failover: primary deployment us-west-2; failover target us-east-1. Test failover in dry-run during canary window (off-peak).
Rollback criteria: sustained p95 > 2x baseline for 15m OR quality regression (decrease in eval score on canonical prompt set > 3pts) -> full rollback to previous capacity immediately.
Quality monitoring: prompt-set eval (200 prompts) run every 4h during canary; human spot-check daily for semantic drift.
Security notes: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration for model keys, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance, data residency for EU customers (future phase).
Quotes: Elena - 'We care most about predictability. If Dedicated can give consistent p95 and 30-40% token-cost reduction that's a win.'
Finance: desire for committed throughput pricing; requested example TCO for 6 and 12 month reserved plans (see pricing deck link).
